title: Day 1 Forecast Discussion
discussion:
Moderate thunderstorms are expected today

---Discussion---

Cold front will sweep through Central Europe

Today is a HSLC scenario, where if thunderstorms initiate due to the cold front, they may turn into embedded supercells within the system.

Due to LLS and DLS, tornado threat isnt ruled out.

Most of the stronger thunderstorms will occur during the afternoon hours into late night.

Also due to high LCL, thunderstorms will bring strong to very strong wind gusts.
